title: Fairness for Text Classification Tasks with Identity Information Data Augmentation Methods
benchmark_measurement: Measurement of unintended bias in text classification models by evaluating prediction score changes when religious identity terms are replaced with their counterfactual pairs (e.g., 'christian' replaced by 'jewish').
findings: The paper's proposed data augmentation methods (IIDA), which include augmenting lists of religious identity pairs, were found to successfully mitigate unintended bias (measured by the CTF gap) in text classification tasks. The methods reduced the model's sensitivity to religious terms without significantly harming overall classification accuracy.
